youtube_title: Why Agents Never Push Term Plans 🧾 #Shorts
youtube_description:
'Insurance + investment, both together!' Here's one real example for a ₹50 lakh cover:

Endowment premium: about ₹1.4 lakh/year. Term plan: about ₹13,000/year.
Agent's year-1 commission: 25% ≈ ₹33,000 on the endowment vs about ₹3,000 on the term plan.
Return on the endowment in this example: about 7.7% a year.

Rule: term plan for insurance, invest separately, and ask the agent what commission he earns.

Source: The Federal, 'Your insurance agent will never suggest a term plan' (May 2022). Example figures; not financial advice.
